mapper.select: SELECT fet.fixed_expense_template_id AS id, fet.fixed_expense_name AS fixed_expense_name, fet.amount AS amount, fet.category_id AS category_id, ec.category_name AS category_name, fet.payment_method_id AS payment_method_id, pm.payment_method_name AS payment_method_name, fet.payment_day AS payment_day, fet.start_year_month AS start_year_month, fet.end_year_month AS end_year_month, fet.auto_generate AS auto_generate, fet.memo AS memo FROM fixed_expense_templates fet LEFT JOIN expense_categories ec ON fet.category_id = ec.category_id LEFT JOIN payment_methods pm ON fet.payment_method_id = pm.payment_method_id WHERE fet.user_id = #{userId} AND fet.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY fet.fixed_expense_template_id ASC
